subject.title: Hermes importer misses current state and provider contracts

question: Should the Hermes importer and generic packaged bundled-plugin discovery repair land together under this protected issue, or should ownership be split into linked fixes?
rationale: The observable failure spans a plugin-owned migration contract and shared persisted plugin-index behavior, so the ownership and landing shape require explicit maintainer coordination even though the expected behavior is already defined.

options.title: Land one coordinated fix
options.body: Repair the Hermes provider and generic packaged discovery path together with one packaged migration proof covering both boundaries.

options.title: Split linked ownership
options.body: Keep this issue canonical while separate linked changes repair the importer and shared plugin registry, with combined end-to-end proof before closure.

recommendation.title: Land one coordinated fix
recommendation.body: Repair the Hermes provider and generic packaged discovery path together with one packaged migration proof covering both boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue supplies the complete cross-boundary reproduction and carries the explicit maintainer-routing signal.
